description.value: Farquhar Auditorium is a 1,200-seat soft-seat performing arts venue located at the heart of the University of Victoria campus. It hosts concerts, lectures, recitals, and professional recordings, drawing audiences from both the campus community and greater Victoria. Touring cyclists exploring Victoria's south end will find the leafy UVic campus itself scenic, with the Farquhar serving as a cultural anchor for events year-round.
